message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: e2e

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  push:
    branches: [ main ]

permissions:
  contents: read

defaults:
  run:
    working-directory: test

jobs:
  kubernetes:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    services:
      registry:
        image: registry:3
        ports:
          - 5555:5000
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version: 1.27.x
          check-latest: true
          cache: true
      - name: Setup staging cluster
        uses: helm/kind-action@1544676c07bb3570fcb70166beaa07c4528fd4aa # v1.15.1
        with:
          cluster_name: timoni-staging
      - name: Setup production cluster
        uses: helm/kind-action@1544676c07bb3570fcb70166beaa07c4528fd4aa # v1.15.1
        with:
          cluster_name: timoni-production
      - name: Build
        working-directory: ${{ github.workspace }}
        run: make build
      - name: Push modules
        run: make push
      - name: Deploy
        run: make fleet-deploy
      - name: Check
        run: make fleet-deploy-check
      - name: Uninstall
        run: make fleet-deploy-uninstall",
  "rationale": "The workflow is a single e2e job that builds, deploys to kind clusters, and runs checks. Go module caching is already enabled via setup-go cache: true, so P-LIT-GHA-CACHE is already satisfied. The CI history shows five successful runs with durations of roughly 3.5 to 6 minutes, providing representative successful-duration history. Adding a job timeout (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT) bounds runaway consumption without changing test coverage or build steps. A 15-minute limit gives about 2.5x headroom over the longest observed run, avoiding false timeouts on valid slow or cold runs while preventing hung jobs from consuming unlimited runner time. No permissions are weakened, no new actions or secrets are added, and no deployment operations are introduced beyond the existing ones.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--112e2b2e7fbe04b8"]
}
